description_en: Changes the network type of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-network-type --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --instance-network-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceNetworkType

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The new network type of the instance. Valid values:

VPC
Classic
parameters.help_zh:
指定网络类型：
VPC：专有网络类型
Classic：经典网络类型
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the instance. This parameter must be specified when VPCId is specified
parameters.help_zh: vSwitch ID，若传入VPC ID的值，则该参数必传
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the instance
parameters.name: private_ip_address
